measures: anonymous election and territory IDs retained from the already sealed minimal handoff
party IDs are re-pseudonymized independently inside each target territory as Q_01..Q_09; no party pseudonym has cross-territory meaning
the same target-local party permutation is used for true and shuffled conditions so the negative control remains valid
raw target-year unemployment/female/youth/underemployment rates are removed from voter cards to reduce year fingerprinting
Afrobarometer source name, fieldwork dates, year, and respondent IDs are not exposed; only broad-stratum posterior means/SDs are exposed
real constituency names, real party names, mappings, weights, geography-confidence labels, outcomes and target years remain private
fresh model context per batch and explicit ban on memory-based re-identification remain mandatory
